title: Explicit published operation -> object/method
summary: RpcServiceRegistry~registerMethod(service, operation, target, methodName) publishes one unary operation. registerCallbackMethod publishes callback operation; registerObject supports atomic validation of an explicit name mapping. Frozen registries reject changes. RpcServiceDispatcher resolves exact service+operation and wraps successful result or RpcServiceFault.
invariants: Only trusted registration code can bind service/operation pairs; caller input must never become a raw ooRexx receiver selector.
Case-sensitive exact strings; duplicate bindings and absent local methods rejected at registration.
The target object lifetime and registration lifecycle are owned by the server.
freeze prevents registration/unregistration on that instance; policy revocation thereafter requires controlled registry replacement, not assuming an unregister will succeed.
Authentication/authorization is a separate gate; registration is an allowlist, not an identity check.
